support.text: For questions, problems and feedback, write to us: gameofusapp@gmail.com

items.a: Game of Us is a two-player game where you guess how your partner, best friend or spouse will answer a question. At the end of every game you get a Reading Score that shows how well you read each other.

items.q: How do you play, and do we need the app?
items.a: Create a room, pick a category and a game mode, and send the invite link or code. You don't need the app: you can play at gameofus.app without an account; in the mobile app you sign in with Google or Apple. A room created in the app can also be joined from a browser, while a room created on the web is played on the web. Once you have both finished, you see your guesses and your Reading Score together.

The Reading Score is not a compatibility test. It doesn't measure whether you think alike, but how accurately you guess what the other person will answer. In other words, it shows how well you know each other.
No. You can play Game of Us with your sweetheart, your best friend or your spouse. You choose the kind of bond when you create the room, and the questions follow.

list.name: Secret Choice (Yes / No)
list.text: Secretly pick your own answer, then guess what your partner picked.

list.name: Prediction (Scenario)
list.text: Predict the answer your partner will give.

list.name: Ranking
list.text: Put the cards in order of importance and see who cares about what.

list.name: Mixed Round
list.text: The modes mix with a surprise in every round. In the mobile app it comes with the “A cup of coffee” package.

list.name: Bluff
list.text: Answer Yes or No and guess, then use a Lie Card to flip at least one answer. At the end, catch the other's lies with a limited number of “Bluff!” calls.

list.name: Red Flag Minefield
list.text: A solo game where you discover your red lines.

items.a: A solo game: each set has 9 situations, and on every card you pick Green, Yellow or Red Flag to decide which situations are a red line for you. At the end you get a result card based on your choices. In the mobile app there is a new set every day in both the Friendship and Romantic categories; you can play each category once a day.

Guides are games suggested for a particular moment, such as Valentine's Day, New Year's Eve or a birthday. Start with whichever you like; the room settings come ready. You'll find them in the mobile app under Profile > Guides, with the “A cup of coffee” package.

items.q: What is the AI analysis, and are my answers private?
items.a: The AI analysis, unlocked with 250 coins in the mobile app, is a commentary on where you read each other best and what surprised you most; you can also get one for your Red Flag result. For games created in the app it is prepared with both players' consent. Your answers are shown to the person you play with only after you have both finished. If an analysis is unlocked, the related game data is sent to an AI service provider; we don't sell your data. See the Privacy Policy for details.

items.q: Is it free, and what are coins for?
items.a: Yes, you can play for free. The web needs no account; you can create one room per browser. The mobile app uses coins:

list.name: Earning coins
list.text: 500 coins when you sign up; 20 for watching an ad (up to 3 times in 24 hours); 25 for sharing your Red Flag result to your story (once a day); 25 for finishing Today's Set (once a day).

list.name: Spending coins
list.text: 100 to create a room, 250 for an AI analysis. Joining a room you're invited to is free.

list.name: A cup of coffee package
list.text: A one-time purchase, not a subscription: 1,000 gift coins, unlimited rooms without spending coins, 10-question sets, Mixed Round and guides; mandatory ads are removed. AI analyses are still unlocked with coins.

items.q: How do I delete my account and data?
items.a: In the mobile app you can permanently delete your account and data via Profile > Settings > Delete My Account (except purchase records that we are legally required to keep). If you can't access the app, write to gameofusapp@gmail.com. The web has no accounts; game data is deleted automatically after a set period.

items.q: Which languages and devices are supported?
items.a: Game of Us supports Turkish, English and Spanish. You can play from any browser at gameofus.app, or in the iPhone and Android app.
